srk_constable.text: Two cells, no windows to speak of and a very small key. It was built in 1856 for the island's rare offenders, and it hasn't seen heavy use. We have an arrest every few years, and the arrested person generally finds their own way home.
Sark's constable and the Chief Pleas keep order. You'd have to go some to get yourself arrested here. Perhaps park a car.
